summary: The registered contrast is high-dose insulin versus basal saline in whole hypothalamus. Of 2,301 author-selected genes, 2,122 paired with the registered output (92.22%). All agreed in direction, and both author-concordance-v2 effect criteria passed for this list. At FDR < 0.05, the paired genes yielded 1,220 author calls, 15 registered calls and 14 shared calls. The proposal passed validation. [Author Table S1](https://ndownloader.figshare.com/files/27952974)
openIssues: The unfiltered author results were unavailable. The paired genes cover 15.48% of the registered output, leaving genome-wide agreement unassessed.
The original limma design was unavailable. GEO identifies five basal hypothalamus libraries, but the publication does not enumerate the basal libraries used in the fit.
